meta.name: brief
meta.description: Clarify a new customer brief, desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. Use for kickoff or a first meeting; do not repeat discovery already supplied.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理客户初期简报,理清目标、约束与待补证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到新客户简报,需要先厘清目标、约束和信息缺口再开工
copy.tagline_en: Turn a new customer brief into clear goals, constraints and open questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handed a new client brief and need to clarify goals before starting work

howto.what: 拿到新客户简报时，Claude 会先读任务上下文契约和方法，再帮你理清期望结果、约束条件和证据缺口，同时保留未知项，并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。
howto.when: 在项目 kickoff 或第一次客户会议时接管；已经提供过的调研信息不会重复追问。若由 @fde 调用，则沿用它当前的脱敏数据包和范围。

say.text: 这是我们新客户的简报，帮我理清期望结果和约束。
say.note: 它会先读方法，再逐项澄清。

say.text: 这份简报里还有哪些未知项和证据缺口？
按方法把这次简报的澄清结果记录下来。
say.note: 方法里的文件名是可选存档位置。

howto.what_en: For a new customer brief, Claude reads the task context contract and the method, then clarifies the desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps, keeping unknowns and separating implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance.
howto.when_en: It takes over at kickoff or a first meeting; discovery already supplied isn't repeated, and when called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Here's a new customer brief: clarify the outcome and constraints.
say_en.note: It reads the method first, then asks.

say_en.text: What unknowns and evidence gaps remain in this brief?
Record the clarified brief using the method's filenames.
say_en.note: Those filenames are optional persistence destinations.
